summary.text: Michael Crider is a Republican who has represented Indiana Senate District 28, which covers Hancock County and portions of Shelby and Marion counties, since 2012.
He is the Majority Whip and chairs the Homeland Security and Transportation Committee.

paragraphs.text: According to his Indiana Senate Republican biography, Crider graduated from the Indiana Law Enforcement Academy in 1981 and the FBI National Academy in 2003, and was previously director of the Indiana Department of Natural Resources Division of Law Enforcement.
He has been a member of Neighborhoods Against Substance Abuse and served seven years as its president.

He is the ranking member of the Veterans Affairs and The Military Committee and also sits on the Appropriations, Health and Provider Services, Joint Rules, and Rules and Legislative Procedure committees.
The page lists his wife as Sherri and his sons as Bryce and Adam, and names six grandchildren.
